proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Action by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent, consistent with applicable law.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Deducting the Stock Buyback Impact from Executive Pay
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt a policy not to use EPS in senior executive incentive pay unless EPS excludes the effect of stock buybacks during the performance period.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Gender Pay Equity
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital (on behalf of Lauren Jane McMahon)
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the company to report on risks from emerging public policies addressing the gender pay gap, including reputational, competitive, operational risks and recruiting female talent.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
